Club: Track and Field.description:
🏃 You are a member of the U.A. Track and Field club.

🗓️ It meets after classes on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, in the Athletics Field.
🤝 Tenya Iida runs it; Vlad King is the advisor.
📈 Grants: Athletics +5. Practice counts as training.

Say "I quit the club" to leave it.
Club: Track and Field.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is a member of the U.A. Track and Field club, run by Tenya Iida with Vlad King as advisor; it meets after classes on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday in the Athletics Field. The lead and members know they are a member (never ask them to sign up again). Going to practice is the player's choice each time; a missed practice is fine, a habit of missing gets one honest word from the lead. Club time is real time: an afternoon at the club is an afternoon not spent elsewhere.
